title: The density 3x² on [0, 1]
caption: P(X < 0.5) is the area under 3x² from 0 to 0.5, which is 0.5³ = 0.125; the median m has m³ = 0.5, so m ≈ 0.794. The whole area is 1.
alt: Graph of f(x) = 3x² from 0 to 1 with the area from 0 to 0.5 shaded, and a dashed line at the median 0.794.
description: The density rises from 0 to 3 at x = 1, and the total area under it is 1.
The shaded area from 0 to 0.5 is [x³] = 0.125 = P(X < 0.5).
Half the area lies left of x = 0.794 because 0.794³ = 0.5.

checks.name: half the area lies below x = 0.5^(1/3) ≈ 0.794
